# The published event catalog

<!-- GENERATED FILE — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Generated by `packages/domain-reference/tools/generate-catalog.ts`; run `npm run catalog -w @pegasus/domain-reference`. -->

The versioned integration events a consumer subscribes to, at `specVersion` **0.3.0**. Every file here is generated from [`packages/domain-reference/src/`](../../../packages/domain-reference/src/), and none of them is written by hand.

The decisions behind them — what is published, how it is versioned, and what a consumer may filter on — are in [`../analysis/published-event-catalog.md`](../analysis/published-event-catalog.md).

## The files

- [`captured.schema.json`](captured.schema.json) — the **captured** face: what anything asserting into the catalog must satisfy. `recordedAt` is forbidden ([SD §1.1]). A `PARTNER_ASSERTED` partner asserts against this one, so it is an external contract too.
- [`queried.schema.json`](queried.schema.json) — the **queried** face: what anything reading out of it is served. `recordedAt` is mandatory.
- [`index.json`](index.json) — the manifest: every published member with its canonical subject family and qualifier, the filter axes and the refused ones, the compatibility classification, and **the owed inventory**.

## What is published

**33 members** — 19 act types, 12 other assertion types and 2 meta-record types. That is the record vocabulary exactly: there is no curated subset and no coarser published layer, because one record carries one `type` and a second classification axis is permanently forbidden ([SD §1.1], [SD §1.3]).

Both schema documents are **closed** (`additionalProperties: false`), and each field [SD §1.1] forbids on the envelope is emitted as `"field": false` — refused by name, not by silence. Validate a record against the `specVersion` it carries, never against a pinned one.

## What a consumer may filter on

The envelope, plus the keys derived from it. Nothing else, and `context[]` is never a default axis ([SD §1.4] rule 1).

- `type` — envelope
- `subject.aggregate` — envelope
- `subject.id` — envelope
- `subjectFamily` — derived
- `factClassFamily` — derived
- `factRef` — derived
- `basis` — payload
- `capturedBy` — envelope
- `outcome` — payload
- `assertedBy.role` — envelope
- `assertedAt` — envelope
- `recordedAt` — envelope — **queried face only**

Refused: `context`, `currentState`, `tense`, `remarkText`, `undeclaredPayloadField`.

## Regenerating

```sh
npm run catalog -w @pegasus/domain-reference
```

`tests/conformance/catalog-staleness.test.ts` fails when what is committed and what the generator produces disagree, and the emitted bytes are a prettier fixed point so the pre-commit hook cannot rewrite them behind a green run.
